name: 76643 · Hewitt, TX
findings: ZIP 76643 (Hewitt) has 25 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 76643 (Hewitt) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 76643 (Hewitt) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 50% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
